I replied to Tobias in a thread on his #central-random message: the ticket is **PD-4821**.

That comes from Hollis's post in #central-team on 9 Jun 2026, which is a channel Tobias belongs to. The brain search turned up the same conversation. Hollis said the Eastbank receiving-door import is attached to that ticket.

I also passed on Hollis's warning from that post. The import file calls the doors E1/E2, but Marrow Agrisupply's booking sheet calls them 01/02. That needs sorting before anyone reimports, or it will create duplicates.

The ticket number appears only in that chat. I didn't find a ticket file for Marrow Agrisupply in the shared files, so I couldn't check it against a ticket record.
